title: SEA-HELM: Southeast Asian Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating linguistic and cultural competence in Southeast Asian languages through five pillars: NLP Classics, LLM-Specifics, SEA Linguistics, SEA Culture, and Safety. While it mentions cultural values and includes a toxicity detection task under the Safety pillar, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific moral and ethical systems.
